title: 10/10 experience
text: We visited the Giralda, the Cathedral, and the Alcázar this morning with Mª José; she was very approachable, kind, and explained everything to us brilliantly.
author: 632virginia

title: Alvaro was an excellent tour guide
text: Alvaro was an outstanding tour guide. He made the tour very interesting with lots of local knowledge and even tips for other places to visit in Seville. This was our first day in Seville, and it was an excellent way to orient ourselves to the city. Having skip the line access enabled us to move much faster during the tour as well.
author: Curiosity04597115343

title: This was well worth the...
text: This was well worth the price to be able to skip the long lines as well as avoid unnecessary stops. Our guide knew which places to stop at and where to not bother with. Would definitely recommend, especially if you despise being in bus sized tour groups.
author: Jessica_K

title: Skip the line tour
